To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) the incidence of thyroid nodules is high in women undergoing breast US, and 2) a subset of these nodules is malignant and would have been missed if not for the screening.
the use of sonographic screening for thyroid carcinoma during breast sonography is associated with a significant increase in the detection of thyroid cancer.

the incidence of thyroid cancer was 1.4% among 1,500 women undergoing screening breast sonography, and that the incidence of malignant thyroid nodules in women with a family history of thyroid cancer was more than three times higher than in those without such a family history.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new methods for the diagnosis of thyroid cancer.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the evidence does not support the use of screening for thyroid cancer with ultrasound in women undergoing screening for breast cancer.
there is no evidence that screening for thyroid cancer by sonography in asymptomatic individuals is effective and that there is no indication that such a screening test should be performed.
there is no evidence to support the use of ultrasound in screening for thyroid cancer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the thyroid gland is a frequent incidental finding on breast sonography, and it should be assessed to exclude malignancy in females with no prior history of thyroid cancer or thyroid dysfunction.
the use of sonographic screening for thyroid malignancy in females undergoing breast ultrasound is not recommended.
the use of sonography for screening of thyroid malignancy in females undergoing mammography for breast cancer is not recommended.
The main takeaway from our work is that

thyroid nodules detected by breast US are not associated with a higher risk of malignancy than those found in patients without breast US, and that breast cancer is not associated with thyroid malignancy.
sonographic screening for thyroid nodules in females with a history of breast cancer undergoing breast ultrasound should be considered.
the use of ultrasound screening for thyroid cancer is not recommended in women with breast cancer.
